open_points.subject: confirm_import
open_points.text: confirm_import: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST leave every write to the record's own module: it MUST NOT write a record itself, MUST NOT open, commit or roll back a transaction, MUST NOT write the migration closure, and MUST NOT apply any value other than those of the kept file of the bound digest, those choices carries and the given instant.
open_points.other_text: confirm_import: [ORCHESTRATION] For a clean mapping it MUST have every record written by its own module in transaction: first each MappedCustomer through make_imported_customer with its name, its kind as = models.CustomerKind, its v1 value, its tax-id answer and instant; then each picked project through write_imported_project with the display name and alias it arrives under and the customer_ref minted for its v1 value, or None when it names none; then each brought-in pointer through write_imported_pointer with the file's digest.
open_points.question: Must the dependency boundary also allow the customer_ref returned by make_imported_customer, or must the orchestration stop applying that minted value to write_imported_project?
